resources.string: LocalFlow uses this to type your dictated text into whichever text field is focused. It reads only the focused field and never sends anything off your own devices.
Tap the dot to dictate, hold it for push-to-talk.
On the PC: right-click the dot → Phone setup → Copy setup line, then press Paste setup line here.
Each one is needed for the dot to work. Tap Open, flip the switch on the system page, then come back.
Show the dot only when a text field is active
Needs the accessibility service (Permissions above). Until it is on, the dot stays visible everywhere.
Press Enter when you say “press enter”

Hold the dot to talk (push-to-talk), release to send. Tap it once for hands-free, tap ✓ when you are done, ✕ to throw the recording away. Drag it anywhere; it snaps to the nearest edge. By default the dot only appears while a text field is active or the keyboard is up.\n\nGrey = ready. Red = recording. Orange ring = hands-free. Blue = the PC is thinking. Green = text inserted. Red ring = something went wrong (a toast says what). If the red ring stays, the PC timed out: tap the dot to retry with the same audio.
